name: DynamicImageModalAPI
tier3: Click a profile avatar/banner to open the image modal; zoom and prev/next must work.

name: NoticesAPI
tier3: Confirm an Ion/Vencord notice bar (if shown) renders under the top bar and dismisses.

name: BadgeAPI
tier3: Open a donor's profile and confirm their vencord.dev badges render (needs network).

name: Settings
tier3: Open the Vencord settings tab from Ion's plugin list; plugin toggles must render. Cloud/Updater tabs are degraded by design (Ion owns those).

name: ConcatenatedComponentExtractor
tier3: Infrastructure: confirm plugins that patch concatenated components (e.g. FakeNitro emoji picker) still work.

name: CrashHandler
tier3: No visible action expected: confirm no crash-report dialog appears during a normal session.

name: SupportHelper
tier3: Expect Vencord's 'unsupported build' helper text on non-official builds — that is upstream behavior, not a bug.

name: WebKeybinds
tier3: Confirm browser keybinds (F5/Ctrl+R reload, Ctrl+W close) behave per your Vesktop settings.

name: WebContextMenus
tier3: Right-click a message/image and confirm web-style context items (Copy Image, Save Image) behave as in Vesktop.

name: WebScreenShareFixes
note: deferred: blocked on screenshare audio parity
tier3: Deferred (Q3): re-test together with Linux screenshare system audio.

name: DisableDeepLinks
tier3: Click a discord:// URL in the browser: no second client should spawn (links are disabled by design).

name: NoTrack
tier3: DevTools → Network: confirm no requests to sentry.io or Discord analytics endpoints fire.

name: AddAttachments
tier3: In a chat, confirm the attachment flow can add a URL as a file attachment.

name: NoTypingAnimation
tier3: Confirm the typing indicator appears/disappears without its animation (needs a live conversation).

name: AlwaysAnimate
tier3: Open the emoji/sticker picker and confirm previews loop continuously without hover.

name: BetterGifAltText
tier3: Hover a GIF embed and confirm the alt text describes the GIF, not just 'GIF'.

name: ServerInfo
tier3: Right-click a server: the ServerInfo entry must open with invite/owner details.

name: petpet
tier3: Right-click a user → Pet Pet: the generated image must appear in the message draft and send.

name: GreetStickerPicker
tier3: Trigger a greeting flow and confirm sticker suggestions render and send.

name: VolumeBooster
tier3: User Settings → Voice: the slider must be able to exceed 100% and audibly boost.

name: FixYoutubeEmbeds
tier3: Paste a YouTube link in chat: the embed must use the fixed player (no broken iframe).

name: FakeNitro
tier3: Emoji picker in a DM: foreign-server emojis must be selectable and render when sent (test together with FakeProfileThemes).

name: ShowHiddenChannels
tier3: Channel list: locked channels must be visible greyed; opening one shows a read-only preview.

name: Experiments
tier3: User Settings → Experiments: page must render; view only, do not flip experiments you do not understand.

name: FakeProfileThemes
tier3: Open a profile → set a gradient; the background must apply and coexist with FakeNitro (test together).
